metrics_mapping.sql_source: SELECT count(*) FROM revenue_transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'new_sale'
SELECT SUM(mrr_value) FROM saas_subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT snapshot_date, total_mrr FROM metrics_daily_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date > now() - interval '12 months'
